snippet.title: Static Signal - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4051260/Static_Signal/

Static Signal is an open world 'action' horror game. Venture through your old office building and even reality as a malicious entity plans to reshape the world into a nightmare, but you can stop it before it's too late. Will you waste your time away, or will you save everyone from extinction?
